text.en:
Subparagraph (c), Section 20, Article 2, Chapter II of Presidential Decree Numbered Two
hundred thirty-one, otherwise known as the Local Tax Code, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(c) Registration fees on large cattle:
(1) Original certificate of ownership P 5.00
(2) Transfer certificate of ownership P10.00
